Things we make, mostly for small teams

Exciting is a small studio in London. We build software, tinker in hardware and explore the potential of simple systems. Right now most of the work goes into Jelly.

What we’re making now

Main focus

Jelly

A simpler shared inbox for small teams, for addresses like support@your-team.com.

  • Claim a new email with “I got this”, so nobody replies twice
  • Talk it over in comments your customer never sees
  • Free for 14 days, then one flat price for the whole team
